title: R.A.M.B.O. Album Art
coreRelationships: The central framed painting is the primary focal point, depicting a figure in distress against a fiery, chaotic background.
The main title typography is large, distressed, and positioned prominently above the artwork, establishing a strong visual hierarchy.
The solid reddish-orange background acts as a unifying field, contrasting with the detailed artwork and providing a canvas for the typography.
The parental advisory label serves as a small, distinct informational element, contrasting in style and placement with the main artwork and typography.
reuseFormula: Recreate the central framed artwork with a new distressed figure and chaotic background, maintaining the painted style and warm color palette. Replace the main title with new distressed uppercase text, and the subtitle with new clean uppercase text, preserving their relative sizes and positions. Ensure the reddish-orange background and Parental Advisory label are consistent.
